commentary: Today, iron ore futures conƟnued to hold up well, with the most-traded contract I2601 closing at 777 yuan, up 0.39% from the previous day. Spot cargoes at ports rose by 3 yuan compared to the previous working day, with PB ﬁnes in Shandong transacted at 777-783 yuan, unchanged from yesterday, and PB ﬁnes in Hebei transacted at 793-796 yuan, up 3 yuan from the previous day. Overall market transacƟons were moderate, with steel mills purchasing mainly for rigid demand and traders selling at appropriate prices. Industrial data today showed that SMM hot-rolled coil inventories conƟnued to build up, while construcƟon materials saw slight destocking, though overall inventory pressure remained. On the news front, the meeƟng is expected to conclude soon, and the upcoming release of content may impact market senƟment. In the short term, ore prices are likely to ﬂuctuate rangebound.
